observedFullRunFailure.serverFailure: accepted-stream read returned OS 35 WouldBlock and the server thread panicked
observedFullRunFailure.clientFailure: the production updater check received reqwest/hyper IncompleteMessage
observedFullRunFailure.causalityLimit: The captured run does not identify why that accepted socket had not supplied a complete request header.

beforeRepair.failure: the old serial server accepted the idle connection, panicked on WouldBlock, and never accepted the second connection before the barrier deadline

coveredInput: an accepted idle preconnection held open while the valid request completes
an empty connection that must not count as an updater request
a request exceeding the 16 KiB header cap that must not count
one valid GET whose header is written in two fragments

repair.summary: The listener now accepts each bounded connection into an independently progressing worker under one 10 second server deadline.
repair.framing: Only a complete UTF-8 origin-form GET request line with an HTTP/1.x version and a CRLF-CRLF header terminator is recorded or served.
repair.invalidInputs: Empty, incomplete, oversized, malformed, timed-out, and stopped connections do not satisfy expected request counts.
repair.workerErrors: Every unexpected connection I/O error is retained, workers are joined, and finish fails with the captured errors instead of allowing a security test to pass for an unintended transport failure.
repair.securityAssertions: The existing signature-tamper, wrong-key, interrupted-download, incompatible-package, malformed-manifest, exact replacement, and byte-unchanged old-app assertions were retained.

independentReviewRepair.finding: The first concurrent implementation discarded handle_request I/O errors. A generic interrupted-download rejection could therefore have passed because of an unintended response write failure rather than the scripted partial body.
independentReviewRepair.resolution: Soft invalid request framing still returns success without counting a request. Actual socket and response I/O failures are captured and make FictionalUpdateServer.finish fail.
independentReviewRepair.sensitivity: The injected response write failure returns an I/O error after a complete request. The test requires finish to panic with that exact error; it fails if the worker error is discarded.

focusedValidation.execution: outside sandbox because the tests bind loopback sockets; all data and artifacts were fictional and disposable
focusedValidation.broaderSuite: not run by this bounded workstream; root owns the new full three-run baseline
